Definition: A class with code that runs when something happens. Every behavior inherits from the Behavior class.
To write your own version of an action that a parent class already has.
An object that a behavior gets when it runs. It tells the behavior which item it belongs to.
A behavior made for Forms. It can get the Form and the Page that is showing.
One drawing of the screen. A Form, like a game, draws many frames every second.
Telling Quorum to treat an object as a more specific type, such as treating an Item as a Label.
